title: Advanced Dashboard Customization
description: Introduced a comprehensive editor for dashboard elements featuring real-time preview, advanced color palette generation, and detailed data annotation capabilities.
highlights: Interactive Dashboard Element Editor with split-screen live preview
Smart Color Palette Generator (Monochromatic, Tonal, Analogous)
Custom Data Labels & Rich Hover Notes (Tooltips)

items.title: Dashboard Element Editor
items.description: A new unified interface for customizing every aspect of your dashboard charts and cards.
details: Right-click any element to access the 'Edit Element' modal
Split-screen design shows real-time updates as you edit
Adjust titles, chart types, and configurations instantly
Responsive preview with size controls (Small, Medium, Large)

items.title: Color Customization System
items.description: Create beautiful, harmonious dashboards with our new color engine.
details: Generate professional palettes from a single base color
Support for Monochromatic, Tonal, and Analogous color harmonies
One-click theme presets (Vibrant, Professional, Sunset, etc.)
Adjust shade counts to match your dataset depth
Colors apply instantly without reloading data

items.title: Labels & Annotations
items.description: Add context and clarity to your data visualizations.
details: Rename axis labels per data point for better readability
Add 'Hover Notes' to display annotative text in tooltips
Add descriptions to Statistic elements to explain metric definitions
Manage all text customizations from a dedicated 'Labels' tab
